notes.title: Tommy Tronic Update Released
notes.notes: Updates to Tommy Tronic have been released. The updates will be applied automatically when your Steam client is restarted.

notes.title: New Release - Tommy Tronic
notes.notes:
Tommy Tronic is now available on Steam!

Battle your way through a haunted woodland as you help Tommy rescue his puppy and teach the bully a lesson!

Enjoy 20% off for the first week.  Offer ends at 10 am Pacific Time on November 4th.
